products.name: Alphonso Mango Pulp
products.title: Alphonso Mango Pulp Exporter & Supplier | AIVA Enterprises
products.description: Premium Aseptic Alphonso Mango Pulp exported globally. 16+ Brix. Ideal for juices, dairy, and bakery manufacturing. Request a bulk quote.
products.overview: Our Alphonso Mango Pulp is extracted from premium, hand-picked Alphonso mangoes sourced directly from the famous Ratnagiri and Devgad orchards in India. Known globally as the 'King of Mangoes', this pulp boasts a vibrant golden-yellow color, rich aroma, and an unparalleled sweet flavor profile.
products.applications: Perfect for premium fruit juices, nectars, yogurts, ice creams, bakery fillings, and artisanal confectionery.
products.packaging: 215 Kg Aseptic Bag in Drum / Cans
products.storage: Ambient temperature. Do not expose to direct sunlight.

faqs.q: What is the shelf life of Alphonso Mango Pulp?
faqs.a: When packed in aseptic bags inside steel drums, our Alphonso Mango Pulp has a shelf life of 24 months at ambient temperatures.

faqs.q: Do you add any artificial colors or preservatives?
faqs.a: No, our pulp is 100% natural. The aseptic processing technology allows us to preserve it without any artificial additives.

products.name: Totapuri Mango Pulp
products.title: Bulk Totapuri Mango Pulp Exporter | AIVA Enterprises
products.description: High-quality Totapuri Mango Pulp from India. Aseptic drums. 14+ Brix. Cost-effective base for blended fruit beverages.
products.overview: Totapuri Mango Pulp is widely preferred in the food processing industry for its ideal blend of sweetness and acidity. Its cost-effectiveness and strong flavor make it the perfect base ingredient for multi-fruit nectars and industrial blends.
products.applications: Beverage bases, multi-fruit juices, jams, and fruit yogurts.
products.storage: Ambient temperature. Keep away from direct sunlight.

faqs.q: Why choose Totapuri over Alphonso for beverages?
faqs.a: Totapuri has a more tart flavor and is highly cost-effective, making it the perfect base for blended juices where pure Alphonso might be too expensive.

products.name: Tomato Paste
products.title: Bulk Tomato Paste Exporter (28-30 Brix) | AIVA Enterprises
products.description: Premium Cold Break & Hot Break Tomato Paste. 28-30 Brix. Exported globally from India. Ideal for ketchup and sauces.
products.overview: AIVA Enterprises processes and exports premium quality Tomato Paste, available in both Cold Break (CB) and Hot Break (HB) varieties. Our tomatoes are sourced from prime agricultural belts in India, ensuring a rich red color and excellent consistency.
products.applications: Ketchup manufacturing, pasta sauces, soups, pizza bases, and ready-to-eat meals.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Hot Break and Cold Break tomato paste?
faqs.a: Cold Break is processed at lower temperatures to retain fresh flavor and color, ideal for premium purees. Hot Break is heated to higher temperatures to inactivate enzymes, yielding a thicker paste ideal for ketchup.

products.name: IQF Strawberry
products.title: IQF Strawberry Bulk Exporter & Supplier | AIVA Enterprises
products.description: Premium Individually Quick Frozen (IQF) Strawberries. Perfect texture and color retention for bakery and dairy applications.
products.overview: Our IQF Strawberries are frozen using advanced Individual Quick Freezing technology immediately after harvest. This locks in their natural red color, firm texture, and sweet-tart flavor profile.
products.applications: Ice cream inclusions, bakery toppings, smoothies, and fruit salads.
products.storage: Must be stored strictly at or below -18°C.

faqs.q: Are the strawberries whole or sliced?
faqs.a: We offer both whole IQF strawberries and sliced/diced options depending on your manufacturing requirements.
